# Unlock the full potential of Visual Studio Code

This introductory course on Visual Studio Code (VSCode) for 
beginners will cover everything from setting up VSCode to mastering its features, 
including debugging, extensions, and collaboration. Ideal for those looking to start coding 
efficiently with the most popular code editor.
